$comment: VO line registry: every line of the a2 voice-over batch (assets-src/vo/manifest.json: 60 advisor + 13 anchor lines of audio-plan section 5.2, the 17 UX section 9 lines, 13 templated lines, 5 legacy tutorial steps; 2 held). text = subtitle (identical to the manifest; a unit test keeps them in sync). Routing metadata: priority 0-3 (P0 critical ... P3 hint), tutorial (P1.T: plays when advisor frequency is 'important'), oncePerGame, gameMonthCooldown (game months between plays), firstFree (the first N plays per game ignore the cooldown), every (after firstFree, only every Nth occurrence speaks), majorPriority (priority when raised by Major news), held (no take yet: subtitle only). The recorded take is the manifest asset 'vo.<id>'. Which events raise which line: data/audio-events.json.

lines.text: Welcome aboard. Let's build a company that lasts.
lines.trigger: gameStarted (new game) after the opening camera move
lines.limit: once per profile; tutorial: once per save

lines.text: Pick a plot near busy roads. Traffic brings customers through the door.
lines.trigger: Build mode opened with 0 player buildings (tutorial step build)

lines.text: Every empire starts with one good store. Let's place ours.
lines.trigger: tutorial step build-store, or first hover on Retail in Build mode

lines.text: Set a price with a healthy margin, but keep an eye on rivals.
lines.trigger: inspector Setup opened on the first retail line

lines.text: Empty shelves earn nothing. Set a restock target so we never run dry.
lines.trigger: first retail line still has no stock policy 20 s after Setup opened

lines.text: Press play and let a month run. The books will tell the story.
lines.trigger: tutorial setup complete and the game paused ≥ 10 s

lines.text: Revenue is vanity, profit is sanity, and cash is king.
lines.trigger: first month close, then Reports opened (or tutorial step books)

lines.text: Nobody buys what they've never heard of. Let's advertise.
lines.trigger: tutorial step run-campaign, or month ≥ 4 with no campaign and brand < 10

lines.text: You've got the fundamentals. From here, every decision compounds.
Ground is broken. That capital is committed, so let's make it earn.
lines.limit: first 2 per game, then ≤ 1 per 12 game-months

lines.text: That build stretches our cash thin. Make sure it pays back fast.
lines.trigger: constructionStarted* with post-build runway < 4 months (replaces build.started)

lines.text: Construction complete. Staff it, stock it, and put it to work.
The factory is finished. Line up supply so it never sits idle.
Our first sale! Small number, big moment. Now let's make it repeatable.
Record revenue this month. Watch our margins as we scale.
We're selling out. Empty shelves send customers straight to competitors.
lines.limit: first per game, then ≤ 1 per 6 game-months

lines.text: Inventory is piling up. That's cash sitting on shelves, not in the bank.
Our cash runway is getting short. Trim costs or line up financing.
lines.limit: once per episode; re-arm at runway > 6 or null

lines.text: We're overdrawn. Every month in the red costs interest and credibility.
lines.tts: We're overdrawn. Every month in the red costs interest, and credibility.
lines.limit: once per episode; re-arm after 2 months ≥ 0

lines.text: Cash is positive again. Nicely done. Let's keep a healthy buffer.
lines.trigger: cashRecovered* (cash ≥ 0 after an episode and runway ≥ 3 or null)

lines.text: Loan approved. Borrowed money is a tool; make it earn more than it costs.
lines.limit: first 2 per game, then ≤ 1 per 12 game-months

lines.text: The bank said no. Strengthen our margins and credit, then ask again.
Loan repaid in full. Less interest, stronger balance sheet.
Our credit rating was downgraded. Borrowing just got more expensive.
Credit rating upgraded. Lenders like what they see.
Interest rates are climbing. Our variable-rate debt just got pricier.
lines.trigger: policyRateChanged* by ≥ +0.5 pp while the player holds variable-rate debt

lines.text: We qualify for a public listing. An IPO could fund real growth.
lines.tts: We qualify for a public listing. An I.P.O. could fund real growth.

lines.text: We're officially public. From now on, every quarter is a report card.
Our share price is surging. The market believes in our story.
Our shares took a beating. Stay calm, and let earnings do the talking.
Dividend declared. Shareholders love a steady, reliable return.
lines.trigger: dividendDeclared* (first time, or the payout ratio changed)

lines.text: Someone is quietly buying up our shares. Watch for a takeover bid.
A new competitor just entered one of our markets. Expect pressure on price.
We've captured ten percent of this market. That's a real foothold.
A quarter of this market is ours. Competitors will be noticing.
We own half this market now. Defend it with quality and brand.
We're the market leader here. Now the hard part: staying there.
We've lost market leadership here. Time to review price and quality.
It's a price war. Protect our margins; winning at a loss isn't winning.
lines.trigger: priceUndercut* (rival ≥ 5% below us and our share −5 pts)
lines.limit: first per game, then ≤ 1 per 12 game-months

lines.text: Research breakthrough! Our technology just moved up a level.
lines.trigger: techLevelUp* (player): first time, and at max − 1

lines.text: Patent granted. For now, that technology is ours alone.
A rival patented that technology. We'll need a license or a new path.
A recession is here. Conserve cash and protect our core markets.
lines.trigger: climateChanged* → recession or panic (chained after news.recession)

lines.text: The economy is recovering. Assets are cheap; a good time to invest.
The economy is booming. Demand is strong, so let's add capacity.
Strong quarter. Revenue and profit are both up. The board is pleased.
lines.trigger: quarterClosed* NI > 0, revenue QoQ ≥ +5% and NI QoQ ≥ +5%

lines.text: A tough quarter. We lost money. Let's find what's dragging us down.
lines.trigger: quarterClosed* NI < 0 after a profitable quarter, or revenue QoQ ≤ −10%

lines.text: Best quarterly profit yet. That's disciplined execution.
lines.trigger: quarterClosed* all-time-high NI with ≥ 4 quarters played (replaces quarter.good)

lines.text: The tax bill is paid. Remember, it's what we keep that counts.
lines.trigger: taxPaid*: first time, then only when tax ≥ 25% of cash

lines.text: We're edging toward bankruptcy. Raise cash now: borrow, cut costs, or sell assets.
One more month in the red and the creditors take control.
Every objective met. That's a business built to last. Congratulations.
The creditors have taken over. Every great magnate has a second act.
lines.tts: The creditors have taken over. Every great mag-nate has a second act.

lines.text: Time's up. We missed the targets, but the lessons are ours to keep.
We're sitting on idle cash. Money that isn't invested isn't working.
lines.trigger: cash > 35% of total assets, no capex for 6 game-months, ≥ 12 months played

lines.text: Our brand awareness is fading. A modest ad campaign would help.
lines.trigger: selling in a (product, city) with brand < 20 and no campaign for 3 game-months

lines.text: Rivals are out-innovating us. Consider building an R&D center.
lines.tts: Rivals are out-innovating us. Consider building an R and D center.
lines.trigger: advisor rule Tech gap (rival tech ≥ ours + 2, contested product) and no R&D building

lines.text: One of our factories is idle. Idle capacity is pure overhead.
lines.trigger: advisor activateIdle on a factory, or utilization 0 for 2 months

lines.text: This city is working well. Consider expanding into another one.
lines.trigger: ≥ 12 months played, one city only, trailing-6-month NI > 0, cash > 2 × supermarket cost

lines.text: Suppliers are taking a fat margin. Could we make it ourselves?
lines.trigger: a purchased input > 20% of COGS for 3 months and no owned upstream producer

lines.text: Good evening. Here's what's moving the markets tonight.
lines.trigger: first anchor line of a session (prefixes the first Major news item)

lines.text: Breaking news: the economy has officially entered a recession.
Economists say the recession is over as hiring picks up nationwide.
Consumer spending hits a record high as the boom rolls on.
The central bank has raised interest rates, effective immediately.
The central bank cuts interest rates to kick-start growth.
Stocks plunge in heavy trading as panic sweeps the exchange.
Stocks close sharply higher in a broad market rally.
Commodity prices spike as supply shortages hit world markets.
lines.trigger: news with a price multiplier > 1 and severity ≥ Notable (content: cocoa_blight ×1.5, tariff_announcement ×1.2, wheat_drought ×1.35)

lines.text: Commodity prices tumble on a global supply glut.
lines.trigger: news with a price multiplier < 1 (oil_glut ×0.7, cotton_harvest_bumper ×0.75)

lines.text: A hotly anticipated newcomer debuts on the exchange today.
lines.trigger: any IPO; for the player's own it chains into adv.ipo.complete

lines.text: Another corporate bankruptcy rattles investors this morning.
Scientists unveil a breakthrough that could reshape the industry.
lines.trigger: content event tech_breakthrough (headline), or a rival reaches max tech (techMax*)

lines.text: Six million dollars and one city. Let's turn it into a company worth ten.
Metropolis: half a million people. The glowing districts are where thirsty customers live.
Construction takes time. Speed things up while the crane works.
Sold against demand: if those numbers ever split, we ran out of stock.
We lost a third of our customers. We can cut price, advertise, or wait.
lines.trigger: tutorial: the month after the rival arrives (UX section 7, 4:40)

lines.text: Borrowing is fine if the new business earns more than the interest.
Same store, new line. More products share the same rent.
Almost there. Keep the shelves full and the brand warm.
Ten million. You've built a real company. Next, we make our own products.
We're selling below cost. Every sale loses money.
lines.trigger: belowCostPrice (player line priced under unit cost)

lines.text: People are starting to recognise our name.
We're a household name in this city.
Big news. Check how it hits our costs.
lines.trigger: Major commodity news: chained after the anchor line

lines.text: We missed a loan payment. The bank is not amused.
Objective complete.
One year left on the clock.
Three months to go. Make them count.
Our first store. Price it smartly and keep those shelves stocked.
lines.trigger: first player building of group retail (buildingConstructed / constructionStarted)

lines.text: Our first farm. Growing our own inputs protects our margins.
lines.trigger: first player building of group farm (buildingConstructed / constructionStarted)

lines.text: We're producing our own raw materials now. Price shocks will hurt us less.
lines.trigger: first player building of group mine_well (buildingConstructed / constructionStarted)

lines.text: Our first warehouse. Buffer stock keeps our stores supplied when demand jumps.
lines.trigger: first player building of group warehouse (buildingConstructed / constructionStarted)

lines.text: Our first R&D center. Better technology means better products and margins.
lines.tts: Our first R and D center. Better technology means better products and margins.
lines.trigger: first player building of group rd (buildingConstructed / constructionStarted)

lines.text: Our first media outlet. Let's put it to work building our brand.
lines.trigger: first player building of group media (buildingConstructed / constructionStarted)

lines.text: Our own seaport. Imported goods now come straight to our door.
lines.trigger: first player building of group seaport (buildingConstructed / constructionStarted)

lines.text: Our first million in revenue. Now let's make the next one faster.
Ten million in revenue. The business has real momentum now.
A hundred million in revenue. We're a serious player now.
A billion in revenue. That's the mark of a true magnate.
lines.tts: A billion in revenue. That's the mark of a true mag-nate.

lines.text: Our first upgrade is complete. More capacity, same address.
Our technology is the best on the market. Now let's protect that lead.
Every empire starts with a single store. Open Manage, pick a city, and construct your first supermarket.
Shelves do not fill themselves. Assign soft drinks to your store, set your price, and set a restock target.
lines.trigger: legacy Godot tutorial step (superseded by UX section 7; kept for the old names and the AudioLab)

lines.text: Time is your engine. Press play and let three months run. Watch the cash begin to flow.
lines.trigger: legacy Godot tutorial step (superseded by UX section 7; kept for the old names and the AudioLab)

lines.text: Nobody buys what they have never heard of. Launch a TV campaign and build your brand.
lines.trigger: legacy Godot tutorial step (superseded by UX section 7; kept for the old names and the AudioLab)

lines.text: Now scale. Grow your corporate value to $20 million. Your rivals are already moving.
lines.tts: Now scale. Grow your corporate value to twenty million dollars. Your rivals are already moving.
